Container.Name: SpeechDock
Container.Overview: Private speech and subtitle workspace using the existing llama-swap service. Registration reloads llama-swap and can interrupt its active models. Prepare writable data, models and llama-swap configuration directories for UID/GID 1000 before starting. The owned models path must be visible to llama-swap at /models/whisper/speechdock. Copy the exact deployed llama-swap executable to the validator host path and keep it executable; the mount is read-only. The optional TV and movie library mounts are read-write so dub captions can be created beside videos; the container user (UID/GID 1000) must be able to create files there. Keep the service on your trusted network.
Container.Requires: Existing llama-swap service; prepared writable directories and matching llama-swap validator.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: SpeechDock web interface and Bazarr endpoint.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent settings, job history, uploads and results; writable by UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: Owned speech models
Config.Description: Dedicated SpeechDock-owned models only; writable by UID/GID 1000. This directory must be visible to llama-swap at /models/whisper/speechdock.

Config.Name: llama-swap configuration directory
Config.Description: Existing llama-swap configuration directory containing config.yaml; directory and file must be writable by UID/GID 1000 for safe atomic updates and backups.

Config.Name: llama-swap validator
Config.Description: Host file containing an executable copy of the exact deployed llama-swap binary. Refresh the copy after updating llama-swap.

Config.Name: Engine URL
Config.Description: Existing llama-swap URL. The initial value is saved as an application setting; change it later in Settings.

Config.Name: llama-swap model path
Config.Description: The path at which llama-swap sees the same host directory mounted above as owned speech models.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy addresses
Config.Description: Only trusted reverse-proxy peer addresses; needed to recognize HTTPS requests through Caddy. Adjust for the actual peer address seen by this container. Never use a wildcard.

Config.Name: TV library
Config.Description: TV library folder for dub captions. Read-write: SpeechDock creates a .en.cc.srt file beside each video it captions and never overwrites a file it did not create. The container user (UID/GID 1000) must be able to create files in the show folders.

Config.Name: Movie library
Config.Description: Movie library folder for dub captions. Read-write: SpeechDock creates a .en.cc.srt file beside each video it captions and never overwrites a file it did not create. The container user (UID/GID 1000) must be able to create files in the movie folders.
